authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7150 nikta, replaced by *nikka in Middle Indo-Aryan, explicitly gives Punjabi nikkā small and Maithili nikāh good. These small/good responses fit that documented semantic range. Exact survey form nikko is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10896 laghu with kk extension explicitly gives loko/lōk light and metathesized halkā/halukā light. These k-bearing forms select the stored *laghukk branch; Chiliss lekū small needs its vowel checked. Exact survey form loko is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
